description: Desktop client for streaming, searching and publishing Kafka events, with bounded memory and on-disk capture. Azure Service Bus and AWS SQS are planned.
notes: EventScope keeps everything it writes in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EventScope - settings.json,
connections.json and sessions/. Nothing is written next to the executable, so
'scoop update' cannot lose your saved connections. That also means uninstalling does
not remove them; delete that folder by hand if you want them gone.
Kafka is the broker this release connects to. Azure Service Bus and AWS SQS are
Releases are not yet code-signed. Every release is built by GitHub Actions from the
public repository and carries a build provenance attestation, which is a stronger
check than an unverified signature - if you have the GitHub CLI:
gh attestation verify (scoop prefix EventScope)\EventScope.exe --repo sinh-r/EventPublisherConsumer
